name: JD Food
old_description: If you are thinking of giving JD Foods an opportunity to earn your business I would fully recommend them.
about:
JD Food is a family-owned food distributor headquartered in Fresno, California, in the agricultural heart of Central California. The company has over 60 years of experience in the food industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The distributor supplies a broad range of products including Center-of-the-Plate proteins, cut-to-order USDA meats, fresh produce, dairy, canned goods, frozen seafood, and pantry items. Through an affiliation with Certified Meat Products, JD Food offers custom protein cuts and marinades. Operations run from a state-of-the-art warehouse with cold-chain logistics, supporting an inventory of thousands of SKUs available for next-day delivery.

JD Food serves restaurants, retailers and wholesalers, catering and special-event operators, and healthcare facilities across Central California. The company also sells directly to consumers through an online ordering platform.

The company emphasizes partnership-based service, leveraging buying power from its membership in UNIPRO Food Service Distributors of America to provide competitive pricing. Community involvement includes partnerships with Off the Front, Fresno Mission, and the Marjaree Mason Center.
